name: Magic Weapon

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Bonus Action touch nonmagical weapon; immediately gains attack/damage bonus and magical status; one-hour non-Concentration source, recast ending; +2 at slots 3–5 and +3 at 6+.

rules.text: Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
The spell ends early if you cast it again.
The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3–5 spell slot.
The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.
